events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Commemorating the day influential rapper Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas in 1996. He would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Legacy of an Icon
angles.copy: Thirty years on, Tupac Shakur's music and message still resonate. We're looking back at the impact of a true hip-hop legend.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the passing of rock guitar icon Jimi Hendrix in 1970. He would have been 84 this year.

angles.name: Guitar Hero Remembered
angles.copy: Jimi Hendrix, a true innovator who redefined the electric guitar. His music continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in 1969, featuring that legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: The album that gave us one of the most famous photos in music history. What's your top track from The Beatles' 'Abbey Road'?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the powerful lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the incomparable Chrissie Hynde! A true rock 'n' roll legend with a voice that still commands attention. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad for it, Liam!
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Wishing a very Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem he sang?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK in 1975.

angles.name: A Song for Peace
angles.copy: More than just a song, 'Imagine' is a global message of peace and unity. What does John Lennon's masterpiece mean to you?

events.title: The Original iPod's Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first iPod in 2001, revolutionising how we carry our music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the first time you held an iPod? It changed everything! How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, who's your favourite Bond and what's the best 007 movie?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Imagine a Legend
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring genius of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel chaos, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: A Double Album Masterpiece
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since its release, The Beatles' 'White Album' remains a sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What's your hidden gem from this iconic record?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991. He would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost a legend. Freddie Mercury's incredible voice and stage presence are truly missed but never forgotten.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' in 1965.

angles.name: A Turning Point Album
angles.copy: 'Rubber Soul' marked a pivotal moment for The Beatles, showcasing their evolving sound and lyrical depth. What's your favourite track from this classic?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the tragic passing of John Lennon in 1980. He would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: A Voice for a Generation
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world lost John Lennon. His music and his message of peace continue to resonate globally. What's his most important song to you?
